how: Candidates came from gh search repos and known official starters; each entry's licence, stars, last push and archived flag were read from gh api repos/OWNER/NAME on 2026-11-10, licence files and README licence lines were read through the same API, and nothing was cloned, installed or run.
second_check: 2026-11-10, a second pass after the search: all 371 repositories were looked up again through the GitHub API. Every one exists, and licence, archived flag and star count match the catalog wherever GitHub can classify the licence. For the 16 repositories whose licence GitHub cannot classify, the licence file was read again and matches what is recorded. Not checked: what pages each template really has, whether a demo link still works, and licence terms stated only on a vendor's own website.
published: Only templates whose licence allows reuse are in this file, each with the credit to give. Repositories with no licence file, a custom or non-commercial licence, or a README that restricts reuse are kept out of the published catalog.
